definitions.explanation: Oil used for cooking and food preparation, including vegetable oil, sesame oil, olive oil, and other oils safe for consumption.

examples.japanese: {食用油|しょくようゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to buy cooking oil.

examples.japanese: {食用油|しょくようゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of cooking oil is going up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{食用油|しょくようゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please dispose of used cooking oil properly.

notes:
A general term for any oil used in cooking, named for its use rather than its source; on labels and in news. At home people simply say ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧.

TYPES:
- サラダ{油|ゆ}: all-purpose vegetable oil
- ごま⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: sesame oil
- ⟦オリーブ→オリーブ：10808_oriibu⟧⟦オイル→オイル：10731_oiru⟧: olive oil
- {菜種油|なたねあぶら}: rapeseed (canola) oil

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{植物油|しょくぶつゆ}→植物油：19177_shokubutsuyu⟧: vegetable oil; named by its source, and includes oils not used for food
